questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: His trials and tribulations, which he claimed were his worse, would be more satisfactory if he actually took the time to organize his thoughts.
questions.explain: The correct answer is WORST. It must be a superlative instead of a comparative, as there are more than two things being compared here.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: My friend had been advised to make prudent investments with her inheritance, so she delayed to buy those stocks offered on the exchange that morning.
questions.explain: The correct answer should be DELAYED BUYING. An infinitive was used instead of a gerund. DELAYED is a verb that is followed by the -ing Gerund.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: The newest ideas presented actually will might cost more, and may have to be considered carefully before going to the board for ratification.
questions.explain: Don't put two MODAL verbs together like this. The correct structure is MIGHT COST.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: Not agreeing to sell his assets and eventually is phasing out his construction company, John will attempt to keep things going until the bank floats another loan.
questions.explain: This should read PHASING, to keep it as a parallel structure with NOT AGREEING. It is a participle, not a verb tense.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: Until the end of the First World War, a little official attention was given to preventing fires, because extinguishing fires was the main concern of fire departments.
questions.explain: A LITTLE means that some attention was given, which has no negative connotation; LITTLE is the correct answer. LITTLE means not much, which gives the sentence its correct negative connotation.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: A frustrating year for the U.S. space program was experienced in 1993 because of lost satellites, delays of space shuttle launches, and a drastically size reduction of the space station.
questions.explain: DRASTICALLY is an adverb, but what is needed is an adjective. DRASTIC is the correct form of the word.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: Marine biology also deals on organisms which directly depend upon bodies of salt water for essities of life.
questions.explain: The answer should be with a different preposition which follows DEALS: DEALS WITH.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: Hakka is very much like Cantonese, with six tones distinguishing meaning between words or words elements within the same vowels and consonants.
questions.explain: This is a noun which has 'become' an adjective to modify ELEMENTS, and there are very few adjectives which end in -S.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: Although Myanmar jewelry has its own characteristics, it was influenced by various Indian styles in which individual jewels blend in rather than standing out.
questions.explain: There is faulty parallelism here; BLEND IN is a two-word verb, and what follows should be the same structure. The correct answer should be: BLEND IN RATHER THAN STAND OUT.

questions.question: Select the underlined section that contains an error: When was the least time you updated the information in your address book?
questions.explain: This should be LAST not LEAST.
